response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS average_payment_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.average_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM rental_totals AS rt JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.average_payment_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id
